about: Every system that raises the team power (전투력) the game shows for a lineup, as the sources list them (nv:33130, nv:43444, the in-game Arena guide quoted by web:sugarpocket-guides). For each: what it raises, where it applies, its materials and whether they are free, time-gated or paid, its cap and diminishing returns, posted gains, efficiency by account stage, and what it does for the stage and Rift brackets of record 003. 'posted' figures are players' own; 'inferred' ones are this record's arithmetic on posted or game-data figures. Game version 1.4.002 (2026-09-23) unless a patch note says otherwise.
efficiency_scale: high: a posted or inferred gain of several % of team power for a cost a player at that stage meets within days; medium: about 1% per few days' income or per ~10,000 KRW; low: well under 1% per the same, or gated by luck or large sums; none: no displayed power.

sources_list.raises: ATK/DEF/HP amplification (%) for the whole lineup, by the polygon area through a constellation's points; later constellations give more per % of area (nv:5693, web:yt-y-bxOrnjIeU).

materials.name: points (별조각) on a constellation
materials.free: open with the account's total cookie stars (constellation 1 with cookie slots); stars come from pulls
materials.paid: more pulls (pickups, memberships)

materials.name: Stellar Points (SP) to reroll the shape
materials.free: passes' free tracks, exchanges (victory medal, guild medal, mileage), check-ins; no steady source (web:yt-njY-LhKqAtM, web:yt-mL9MSX3QD94)
materials.paid: Stellar Link Pack Vol.1 32,000 KRW (for 80%+ everywhere), Vol.2 79,000 KRW (for 90%+) (web:yt-FrKqf5lhZBs); Crumble Pass special rewards 1,000 SP (dc:68148)

sources_list.cost_per_roll: 10 SP unlocked; 10/30/60/100/150/220 SP with 1–6 points locked (web:sugarpocket-stella)
sources_list.cap: up to 12 points per constellation, 100% area; constellation 8 is still the frontier in October. A point opens every 15 cookie stars: constellation 8 at 660, 8-5 at 690, 8-6 at 705 (dc:81196, dc:78964, dc:78814, dc:77737)
sources_list.diminishing: Constellation 8 pays 1.3% amplification per 1% of area (1.0 on 7; dc:78814, dc:78964). Area per SP falls fast: 91% (8 points) ≈ 1,900 SP, 95% (10) ≈ 5,280–7,900, 100% (12) ≈ 150,000–400,000 (dc:68586, dc:56417, nv:43444, dc:73840, web:yt-mL9MSX3QD94). New points need ever more cookie stars (dc:76290).

posted_gains.cost: not posted: completing the 3-point triangle on constellation 8, most likely by opening its third point with cookie stars
Stellar with Resolve and gear together

efficiency.early: high: rolls at 10 SP to 60–70% on the open constellations; don't lock (nv:5693)
efficiency.mid: high: the hexagon at 6 points and the octagon (91%, ~1,900 SP) at 8 (dc:55570, nv:43444)
efficiency.late: high while new points open (+10–13% a step posted, dc:77329, dc:68732), but points cost cookie stars; low past 95% on an old constellation
efficiency.at_2_2g: high up to 8-3, free from pulls (dc:76290): one step was +10% at 2G. Past 8-3: ~45 paid cookie stars, ₩2.3–4.2M upper bound (dc:50913), gain unposted.

sources_list.bracket_effect: Moves every bracket line at once; the only posted single step that moved a 2G account a full 0.2G.
sources_list.spend_order: Roll unlocked to ~70% early; shape later constellations first: hexagon at 6 points, octagon at 8, 95% at 10 (web:yt-5XXDHBHnISU, web:yt-mL9MSX3QD94). Open premium pulls up to 8-6 rather than hoard (dc:82029).

sources_list.raises: Account stats from the guild's research: element damage and ATK/DEF/HP amplification nodes (14-2 Light damage +10%, 15-3 HP amp +7%; dc:81723, dc:78621). crumb.gg's calculator example applies a guild ATK amp of ×1.30 (dc:82457).

sources_list.raises: Displayed power for free: the formula weights attackers high, healers/tanks/supports low, and gear lines by what the lineup lacks (crit resistance, accuracy/focus below target).

materials.name: a stage gear preset and lineup chosen for displayed power

materials.note: power-padding helps only stages and the Rift (nv:41221)

sources_list.diminishing: A padded preset loses real stats (skill haste, amp); accuracy past ~1,000 adds little power (dc:56391). A decompiled formula (claimed) puts power at √(offense × survival), crit resistance inside survival (dc:81470).

posted_gains.cost: commenters' guess: a gear or formation change

efficiency.late: unmeasured; used when within a few % of a line
efficiency.at_2_2g: unmeasured: record 003's pushers say a power-rolled stage preset shows more than the conquest preset; no capture gives the difference

sources_list.bracket_effect: Designed for exactly this: pad across the next 40% (or 60%) line, then fight.
sources_list.spend_order: Keep a pure-power stage preset and swap to it when a line is within reach (record 003, dc:76290).

sword 20–21, bow 19, rest 15; the exception dc:76290 reached 4G with no plate above 18

efficiency.early: high: all to 5 then 10 is cheap
efficiency.mid: medium: 10→15 with free Chocosteel (~4 days of idle per level near 15, inferred)
efficiency.late: low: 2% steps with shatter risk; whale lane
efficiency.at_2_2g: medium for any slot below 15 (sword, bow, staff first); low past 15. At 1.6G one step 14→15 bought ~0.5 chapters of 35% reach (inferred).

sources_list.patch_notes: 2026-09-23: cap 25; a shatter drops 2 levels instead of to 10; restore with Syrup; compensation for past shatters (dc:72150). 2026-10-08 (announced): Chocosteel and Syrup in the mileage shop; Rift exchange limits 5 → 10 (nv:50417, web:crumbgg-patches-20261007).
